rows.question: I am in Surau Al Mahdi, how can I go to Surau At Taqwa?
rows.text:
Route status: confirmed
From Surau Al Mahdi to Surau At Taqwa, the mapped route is about 364 m and takes about 5 minutes on foot. It follows mapped paths with no flood-related or closure issues recorded.
1. Start at Surau Al Mahdi and walk to the nearest mapped path.
2. Follow the mapped paths for about 364 m.
3. Arrive at Surau At Taqwa from the nearest mapped path.
Worth knowing:
• Route starts at the nearest mapped path to Surau Al Mahdi; its entrance is not mapped.
• Route ends at the nearest mapped path to Surau At Taqwa; its entrance is not mapped.
• This route uses 1 road crossing: 1 with no recorded crossing type.
• Crossing type and traffic control on this route are not checked yet.
• Outside the detailed study area (Elmina Urban Park + Lakeside Mall frontage), path and place facts come from OpenStreetMap only.

rows.question: Boleh saya tolak kereta sorong dari Car Park B ke taman permainan?
rows.text:
Status laluan: sebahagian belum disahkan
Ya, ada laluan kereta sorong yang dikira dari Lakeside Mall Car Park B ke Taman Permainan, kira-kira 5,895 m (sekitar 84 minit berjalan). Beberapa bahagian laluan belum disemak, jadi belum boleh dipastikan sesuai untuk kereta sorong.
1. Mula di Lakeside Mall Car Park B.
2. Ikut laluan yang dikira ke Taman Permainan (lihat paparan 3D).
Perlu diketahui:
• Laluan ini sebahagiannya belum disahkan. Pihak pasukan township diminta semak 10 daripada 331 item yang belum disemak, dengan 321 lagi menunggu. Antara item: Incline (%) pada ramp tanpa nama (had 8.3%), Steps dan Width (m) pada footway tanpa nama, Steps, Incline (%) dan Width (m) pada Persiaran Alstonia, serta Sidewalk, Steps dan Incline (%) pada Bulatan Elmina dan Persiaran Metafasa.
• Data laluan dan Lakeside Mall Car Park B ialah nilai demo, belum ditinjau (demo values, not yet surveyed).
• Route ends at the nearest mapped path to Taman Permainan; its entrance is not mapped.
• Di luar kawasan kajian terperinci (Elmina Urban Park + Lakeside Mall frontage), maklumat laluan dan tempat hanya daripada OpenStreetMap.

rows.question: 坐轮椅从Elmina Lakeside Mall去Elmina Urban Park怎么走？
rows.text:
路线状态: 部分未核实
